title: Translation tools (Google Translate, DeepL, Microsoft Translator)

beginner.title: Translate text and messages
beginner.outcome: You can: translate everyday text and check it
beginner.practice: Translate a message and back-translate it to check meaning

beginner.title: Translate signs and documents with your camera
beginner.outcome: You can: read menus, signs and forms in other languages
beginner.practice: Download an offline pack and translate a printed page

beginner.title: Have a conversation across languages
beginner.outcome: You can: talk with someone who speaks another language
beginner.practice: Practise a two-way conversation with a friend

intermediate.title: Translate whole documents
intermediate.outcome: You can: translate files while keeping layout
intermediate.practice: Translate a one-page leaflet and compare tools

intermediate.title: Judge translation quality
intermediate.outcome: You can: know when machine translation is good enough
intermediate.practice: Rewrite a complex paragraph so it translates well

expert.title: Multilingual workflows
expert.outcome: You can: publish and support in several languages
expert.practice: Set up a glossary of 20 terms for your work

expert_validation.note: AI-drafted outline; to be validated by a practitioner and an educator in this field.
